---
name: Editorial or accessibility correction
about: Report a typographical, formatting, link or accessibility issue
title: "[Editorial] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## SDAF version

Identify the version concerned, for example `1.0`.

## Location

Provide the Part, annex, section, requirement, table, figure and page number where possible.

## Current wording or presentation

Quote only the minimum text necessary, or describe the current presentation.

## Proposed correction

State the specific correction you recommend.

## Reason

Explain why the correction is needed.

## Methodological effect

Confirm one of the following:

- [ ] This is an editorial or accessibility correction and does not intentionally change methodological meaning.
- [ ] This may affect methodological meaning and should be reviewed as a normative ambiguity.

## Additional evidence or context

Add links, screenshots or supporting information where useful.

## Submission checks

- [ ] I searched existing open and closed issues for the same matter.
- [ ] I have not included confidential, personal or proprietary information.
- [ ] I have identified any relevant third-party material.
